scenes.title: Boiled Coconuts and a Banquet
scenes.summary: Fedya and Senya haze rookie cook Denis by making him shave and boil coconuts, and Dmitry Nagiyev arrives to announce an all-night banquet with a bonus for the whole staff.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's New Movie
scenes.summary: Nagiyev boasts that the banquet celebrates the wrap of a new comedy film starring himself, and as soon as he steps away, Senya mocks commercial Russian movies.

scenes.title: My Favorite Oil
scenes.summary: Max, Fedya, and Senya act out a parody of shameless product placement using a bottle of cooking oil, and Fedya challenges Senya to admit what movies he likes.

scenes.title: The Restaurant Siege
scenes.summary: In Senya's action-movie daydream, Nagiyev plays a suave gang leader who takes the staff of Claude Monet hostage in the dining room and notices that one cook is missing.

scenes.title: A Chef's Weapon
scenes.summary: The gang boss orders his henchmen to comb the entire restaurant for Senya, and Action-Hero Senya takes them out one by one in the kitchen using forks and kitchen tools.

scenes.title: Sergeant Meat-Grinder
scenes.summary: Fedya warns the gang boss that Senya is actually Sergeant Meat-Grinder from special forces catering, and Senya swings into the dining room to defeat the villains.

scenes.title: The Chandelier and the Beef
scenes.summary: When the villain aims a gun at Senya, Chef Barinov intercepts the bullets with a tough roast of beef and drops the dining-room chandelier on the gang leader.

scenes.title: Hot Pizza
scenes.summary: Snapping back to reality, Fedya laughs at Senya's action-hero daydream and reveals his own favorite genre — a romantic fantasy where he delivers hot pizza to Vika and Nastya.

scenes.title: Browser History
scenes.summary: Nastya scolds Fedya for his shameless daydream and insists Kostya never watches such things, while at a cinema Chef Barinov and Elena suffer through a vulgar movie trailer.

scenes.title: Zombie Movies
scenes.summary: When the cooks tease German about his movie tastes, German coldly explains that he prefers zombie movies because they show human nature honestly — launching a zombie kitchen nightmare.

scenes.title: The Unknown Infection
scenes.summary: In German's zombie tale, Max tells Senya and Fedya that Lyova bit him just as the TV news reports a zombie virus outbreak in Moscow, and a customer orders brains.

scenes.title: Hit with a Frying Pan
scenes.summary: As the staff barricade the doors against the zombies, Vika smacks Max with a frying pan for lying to her, and Senya tries to chop off his own bitten finger.

scenes.title: Timur's Evacuation
scenes.summary: Losing his nerve with the cleaver, Senya begs his friends to tie him up and wait for a vaccine, and produce supplier Timur arrives in the alley offering paid evacuation.

scenes.title: Bloody Mary
scenes.summary: Timur refuses to abandon his zombie nephew because family respect comes first, and when Louis strikes a groaning Chef Barinov, Barinov reveals he just has a hangover.

scenes.title: Brains French-Style
scenes.summary: At the end of German's dark story, zombie Senya bites Fedya while German happily cooks gourmet brain delicacies for the undead, leaving the real cooks disturbed by German's humor.

scenes.title: Kitchen on Mars
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov drops by the kitchen after finishing a bottle of Irish whiskey and tells the crew he loves science fiction, launching a futuristic story set on Mars in 2114.

scenes.title: The Emperor of the Galaxy
scenes.summary: In 2114 aboard the space restaurant, Chef Barinov barks cosmic menu orders at his brigade until a hologram of Nagiyev warns that the Emperor of the Galaxy is landing.

scenes.title: Allergy to Salt
scenes.summary: When the galactic Emperor rejects his dish because of a salt allergy and threatens to vaporize the restaurant, Barinov discovers his clone ruined the meal before waking up.

scenes.title: Revenge on the Director
scenes.summary: At the real movie banquet, Nagiyev storms into the kitchen furious that the director is making the sequel without him, pours laxative into the desserts, and daydreams of Hollywood.
